slice: web-portal (apps/fishsense-lite-web; the only app under apps/)

activities.name: / (public landing, app/page.tsx)
activities.purpose: SSR, force-dynamic, fetches cached with revalidate 300s. Shows project-hub cards grouped as Laser / Head-Tail / Species / Slate Labeling (links to ${LABELER_BASE|LABEL_STUDIO_URL}/projects/{id}), then static Results (two Superset dashboards) and Administration (Temporal UI) cards. Shows a 'Some projects could not be loaded' notice when degraded>0. Has a Sign-in button to /portal. No auth. Logic lives in lib/active-projects.ts, lib/label-projects.ts and lib/sections.ts. Drops unpublished projects and projects where LS finished_task_number>=task_number (fails open).
touches: label-studio: GET /api/projects/{id} (throttled via lib/label-studio-limiter.ts, uses Promise.allSettled)

activities.name: /portal (portal index, app/portal/page.tsx)
activities.purpose: Hub page. A signed-out user is redirected to /api/auth/signin?callbackUrl=/portal. A signed-in user outside PORTAL_ALLOWED_GROUPS gets a dead-end page explaining why, with a 'Sign out and retry' server action. Otherwise it shows name, email and groups, a sign-out server action, and cards from lib/portal-sections.ts (triage, calibration). Makes no API calls.

activities.name: /portal/calibration (dive calibration links)
activities.purpose: Gated by requirePortalUser (app/portal/guard.ts). Table of every dive (calibration-links.tsx) showing label '{name||Dive id} #{id}', date, and a has-own-slate tick (dive_slate_id != null). Each row has a <select> of source dives (those with dive_slate_id != null, sorted by id, excluding itself) plus Save and Clear buttons. Filter: 'only needing link'. Writes go through server actions setCalibrationSourceAction and clearCalibrationSourceAction in actions.ts. Each action re-checks auth and authz, refuses self-links, then calls revalidatePath('/portal').

activities.name: /portal/triage?kind=laser|headtail (mobile triage)
activities.purpose: Gated. Tabs for Laser and Head/tail; an unknown kind falls back to laser. loadQueue (lib/triage-queue.ts) takes the live project ids from the fishsense-api, sorts them newest first (id desc) and resolves each LS project one at a time: at most 24 resolved, 12 walked and 30 task hydrations. It lists page 1 of tasks, skips is_labeled, hydrates each task and filters with rejectionReason (lib/triage.ts: title suffix, from_name, requiredLabels Snout/Fork for headtail), returning 12 items. The client (triage-client.tsx) shows the frame via /api/triage/image/{taskId} with pinch-zoom and keypoint overlay, plus Accept, Skip and Undo. Skip writes nothing. Accept posts the prediction's result verbatim to LS. Undo deletes that annotation.
touches: label-studio: POST /api/tasks/{id}/annotations/ {result, lead_time, was_cancelled:false} (server action acceptAction)

activities.name: /api/triage/image/[taskId] (route handler, image proxy)
activities.purpose: Portal-authz gated (403 otherwise). Takes a positive integer task id only. Fetches the LS task with ?resolve_uri=true and reads data.image. s3:// or gs:// returns 502 'unresolved'. An absolute http(s) URL is fetched without auth, but only when its host is the LS host or listed in TRIAGE_IMAGE_HOSTS (else 502 'blocked'). A relative path is fetched from LS with the Bearer token. The body is streamed back with cache-control private, max-age=3600.

activities.name: /api/auth/[...nextauth] (NextAuth handlers)
activities.purpose: Auth.js v5 GET/POST handlers: signin, callback/authentik, signout and session. The config is in auth.ts: Authentik provider, scope 'openid email profile groups', JWT session, trustHost. The callbacks in lib/auth-callbacks.ts copy access_token and profile.groups into the JWT and then the session.

activities.name: error boundary (app/error.tsx) and root layout (app/layout.tsx)
activities.purpose: The error boundary logs the digest and offers a retry. The layout adds a footer showing the package.json version (0.13.0) and uses Tailwind light/dark classes.

api_endpoints.semantics: Returns List[int], the DISTINCT LaserLabel.label_studio_project_id where it is not null and superseded=false. incomplete=true adds completed=false OR completed IS NULL. gated=true keeps only projects where some live label's image has a LaserPrediction with gate_verdict not null AND none has gate_verdict null (_gate_scan at :386, a correlated EXISTS over an aliased label table). gated=false is the complement; omitted means no filter. The web always sends incomplete=true&gated=true (lib/fishsense-api.ts GATED_KINDS = {laser}). Cached with revalidate 300 on the landing page and 0 in triage.

Returns List[int], the distinct HeadTailLabel.label_studio_project_id where it is not null and superseded=false. incomplete adds completed false or null. There is no gated flag. Used by the landing page and the headtail triage queue.
Same shape as headtail, over SpeciesLabel. Used by the landing page only.
Same shape, over DiveSlateLabel. The web kind is 'dive-slate' and the section is titled 'Slate Labeling'. Used by the landing page only.

Returns every Dive row (List[Dive]) with no filter and no ordering. The web types only id:int, name, dive_datetime, priority, dive_slate_id and calibration_dive_id (lib/dives.ts). Fetched with revalidate 0 by the calibration page.

Sets Dive.calibration_dive_id = source_dive_id and returns dive_id (int). 400 on a self-link, 404 if either dive is missing. No body. It does NOT check that the source has a slate; only the UI restricts that. The web validates both ids as non-negative integers (safeId).
Sets calibration_dive_id=NULL and returns 204. Idempotent; 404 only if the dive is missing. Note the trailing slash.

HTTP Basic with FISHSENSE_API_USERNAME/PASSWORD (a service account), sent to the interior URL http://fishsense-api:8000, which bypasses Traefik and Authentik. The user's identity is never forwarded to the API. v2 needs instead: a user bearer token (the session already keeps the Authentik access_token), or a service principal plus a tenant slug.

api_endpoints.route: v2 targets to build (proposed, not existing)
api_endpoints.file: services/fishsense-services-api (v2 exposes only /healthz and /tenants/{slug}/devices today, app.py:84-130)
api_endpoints.semantics: Proposed routes: GET /tenants/{slug}/label-studio-projects?kind=laser|head_tail|species|slate&incomplete=true&gated=true -> [int]. GET /tenants/{slug}/dives -> [{id uuid, name, dived_at, priority, slate_template_id, calibration_source_dive_id, v1_id?}]. PUT /tenants/{slug}/dives/{id}/calibration-source/{source_id}. DELETE /tenants/{slug}/dives/{id}/calibration-source. Each needs an admin-role check to replace PORTAL_ALLOWED_GROUPS.

shared_helpers.name: liveProjectIds / isPublished / hasOutstandingTasks (one definition of 'live project')
shared_helpers.used_by_slices: web landing + triage; semantics mirror v1 API project-ids endpoints and LS sync (label-sync slice)

shared_helpers.name: getAccessToken (LS refresh-token -> Bearer JWT, cached, deduped, TTL default 240s, 30s skew)
shared_helpers.used_by_slices: web only (orchestrator has its own LS client)

shared_helpers.name: QUEUE_KINDS (title suffix 'Laser Calibration Labeling' / 'HeadTail Labeling', from_names, required labels)
shared_helpers.used_by_slices: must match orchestrator LS project creation (LASER_PROJECT_TITLE_SUFFIX) and sync activities' from_name/label parsing (label-studio slices)

shared_helpers.used_by_slices: web only; v2 replaces with membership role

contracts: No fishsense_shared or fishsense-api-sdk use. The web is TypeScript and hand-types its responses (lib/dives.ts Dive type; number[] for project ids).

The Label Studio task shape used by triage (lib/triage.ts LsTask/LsPrediction/LsRegion): regions are percentages; the fields value.x, value.y, value.keypointlabels[0], original_width, original_height and from_name are read back by the v1 sync activities, so accept posts the prediction's result verbatim.
LS project title format '{dive.name} #{dive_id} - {suffix}' (diveNameFromTitle). In v2, dive ids become uuids, so the orchestrator's title format and this parser must agree.
There are no object-store keys in the web itself. Frames come via LS resolve_uri, either as presigned URLs (host must be in TRIAGE_IMAGE_HOSTS) or as LS-relative paths.
PLAN §6.1: the v2 port should use a generated openapi-typescript client with tenant-scoped paths and no v1-compatible endpoints.
v2_schema_gaps: No schema gap for calibration linking: dives.calibration_source_dive_id exists (0005, FK plus a not-self CHECK), and dives has UPDATE grant (0005:38). The API endpoints are missing, though.

The dive list maps fields: v1 dive_datetime -> v2 dived_at; dive_slate_id -> slate_template_id; calibration_dive_id -> calibration_source_dive_id; id int -> uuid (v1_id bigint kept). The web's safeId (non-negative int), numeric sort and '#id' label must change.

Project-ids: laser_labels, head_tail_labels, species_labels and slate_labels have ls_project_id, completed (NOT NULL, so no null branch) and superseded (0010). This is enough; the endpoint is missing.

Gated predicate: v2 laser_predictions.gate_verdict exists (0011, 'auto_accepted' added in 0014). Predictions are append-only (GRANT SELECT, INSERT, 0011:122) with a current_laser_predictions view (DISTINCT ON capture_id ORDER BY seq DESC). The gate must read current_*. UNCERTAIN: how the gate records a verdict with no UPDATE grant (insert a new row?). That is the gate slice's decision, but it determines this predicate.

No label_studio_projects table with a title or publish state. The web gets those from LS directly, so this is not needed (label_studio_sync_cursors has kind+ls_project_id if a project list is wanted).

Authz: memberships.role is free text (0002:41) with no defined 'admin' value. A tenant-admin role that covers calibration-source edits and triage is needed (PLAN §4.2 line 347-349). Not checked: whether role values are constrained anywhere else.
dependencies: Depends on the v2 API auth (Authentik JWT -> users/memberships -> tenant) plus the four endpoint groups above. Today it depends on the v1 fishsense-api label and dive controllers.

Depends on the Label Studio laser-label sync (already ported) and on the headtail/species/slate syncs to flip completed. Otherwise cards and queues persist up to one sync cycle; the hasOutstandingTasks LS check narrows this.
Depends on the auto-accept gate slice (gate_verdict), for the laser gated=true filter.
Depends on the orchestrator's LS project creation (title suffixes, from_name 'laser'/'kp-1', Snout/Fork labels) and LS storage presigning (object-store host goes in TRIAGE_IMAGE_HOSTS).
Triage accept feeds the laser/headtail sync activities (they read the stored annotation).
Nothing else depends on the web. Superset and Temporal UI are only linked (static-links.ts); the Superset dashboard slugs must survive the §9.20 consumer port.
Deploy: v1 deploy/incus/compose.yml 'web' service (image ghcr.io/ucsd-e4e/fishsense-lite-web). At cutover the v2 repo needs its own build/promote for the web app (PLAN §6.1/§9.9).
gotchas: The portal authz fails CLOSED. With PORTAL_ALLOWED_GROUPS unset or empty, everyone is denied. The group name must match exactly (prod: 'FishSense-Prod-Admins'); see deploy/incus/compose.yml:86-111 and lib/authz.ts.
The OIDC request must ask for the 'groups' scope, or every session has no groups (auth.ts). v2 clients must also request the 'org' scope (PLAN §4.2).

Server actions are public endpoints. Every action re-checks the session and authz BEFORE any write (actions.test.ts 'checks the session BEFORE touching the API'). The v2 API should enforce this itself, since in v1 the API enforces nothing.
A self-link is refused in three places: the UI, the server action and the API (400). v2 also has a CHECK constraint.
Setting a calibration source changes measured fish lengths: a borrowed calibration gives -8..+2% error against about 1% for the dive's own (lib/authz.ts comment).
Skip writes NOTHING to LS or the DB. Writing a skip would flip completed/is_labeled and permanently exclude the image (lib/triage.ts, triage/actions.ts).

Headtail predictions missing Snout or Fork must be refused, not offered as partial. The sync writes x/y only when both are present but sets completed anyway, which permanently excludes the image (lib/triage.ts:60-75).
Accept posts the prediction's result verbatim, with lead_time in ms (used to detect rubber-stamping).
LABEL_STUDIO_API_KEY is a refresh token. Exchange it at /api/token/refresh for a Bearer JWT (about 5 min) and re-mint on 401/403 (lib/label-studio.ts, label-studio-tasks.ts authed()).
Hosted LS rate-limits (429). Use a shared throttle plus Retry-After, and resolve projects lazily and sequentially in triage (budgets 24/12/30).

LS task list rows lack predictions and annotations, so each task must be fetched from the detail endpoint to judge it (triage-queue.ts:63-78). DRF answers a page past the end with a 404, which is not an error.

The image proxy takes a task id only, never a URI, to avoid an open proxy/SSRF, and presigned hosts are allowlisted. TRIAGE_IMAGE_HOSTS is NOT set in deploy/incus/compose.yml, so presigned object-store frames may currently be blocked (UNCERTAIN whether prod LS returns relative paths instead).
LABEL_STUDIO_ENABLED is compared against a truthy allowlist, because the string 'false' is otherwise truthy. The kill switch also blanks triage (lib/label-projects.ts).
A discovery failure must surface as an error, never as an empty queue (triage-queue.ts:106-114). The landing page shows a degraded notice when LS drops projects.
Filtering fails open: a missing is_published or task counts keeps the project. finished_task_number falls back to num_tasks_with_annotations.
The env proxy is lazy (lib/env.ts), and NextAuth uses a function-form config so that `next build` works without AUTH_* set. The landing page must stay public and work without AUTH_*.
AUTH_URL must be set in prod, or OAuth callbacks get built against 0.0.0.0:3000 (README).
v1 SSR calls the API on the interior network with Basic auth, bypassing Traefik forwardAuth. Do not switch to the public host (README).
Route order in v1: the literal label-studio-project-ids path must be registered before {image_id} (label_controller.py docstrings). Avoid the same collision in v2.
Dive names are not unique, so '#id' is kept in project titles and labels.
size: 1 app (apps/fishsense-lite-web, v0.13.0): Next.js 15.5.21 App Router, React 19.2, next-auth 5 beta.32, Tailwind 3.4, vitest 4, standalone Docker (node:24-alpine) built from the repo root. About 45 source/config files. Non-test TS/TSX is about 2,900 lines (largest: triage-client.tsx 417, label-studio.ts 267, label-studio-tasks.ts 243, triage-queue.ts 238, triage.ts 220, calibration-links.tsx 216). Tests are about 2,700 lines: 199 test cases in 22 files (188 unit, 11 integration). There are 4 pages (/, /portal, /portal/calibration, /portal/triage) and 2 route handlers (NextAuth, image proxy). It calls 7 distinct v1 API endpoints (4 project-ids, dive list, calibration-source PUT and DELETE) and 7 Label Studio endpoints. No other app exists under apps/.
